page.layout: One column of running text, with a narrow blank column to its right beside the text. Page number at the top right. Running head at the top. Signature and catchword at the foot. Text on the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: teris regio annulo sigillatis, ad hoc facinus obeundum, ad Prouinciarum Præfectos statim volitant, cursores regij, in Susa publicè pendet Edictum, stat decretum, restat solum executio. Misera herclè, & deploranda gentis Iudaicæ conditio, Edictum iniustissimum,

Sed interim, quid est, quod ita barbarè oppressi, & in tantas detrusi angustias tandem moliuntur Iudæi? num seditionem meditantur? num ad arma convolant? aut Reginam Esther ex eorum gente oriundam sica instruunt? vel veneno, ad interficiendum Regem? vt ea ratione, vel ipsi in aquis turbulentis effugerent, vel communem solum publicæ calamitatis sortem subirent, vel saltem illatam sibi iniuriam quadantenus vindicarent? nihil minus, eorum arma, vt semper Ecclesiæ (vt sæpè dixi, nec tamen satis dici potest) preces & lachrymæ: In omnibus Prouincijs, oppidis & locis (inquit Scriptura) quæ ad crudele Regis dogma peruenerat, planctus ingens erat apud Iudæos, ieiunium, vlulatus,

page.notes: The running head and page number are read as printed. Signature "E" at the foot. The mark at the lower right is read as a catchword "&c" and is doubtful. Italic passages are marked where the type is clearly slanted; the boundaries of "planctus ingens erat" are uncertain. Show-through and the neighbouring page edge at the left are left out.
